about_the_game:
About the Game

Meat Market is a narrative-driven simulation game set in a post-apocalyptic world. After the murder of his daughter, the main character runs a butcher shop to earn money and take revenge. He captures people from the community that killed her, butchers them, and sells their body parts to zombies.

⚠️ This game contains excessive gore, dismemberment, and dark themes.

Coldwater

A safe zone where what's left of humanity tries to rebuild civilization. Here, you can trade goods, decorate your home, and spend time in unique places like the local casino.

Harrowpine

Once a peaceful town, now a hub for the undead. You run your butcher shop here—capturing victims, processing them, and selling fresh human meat to hungry zombies.

Ratwood

A rotting anarchist camp deep in the forest. The people who killed your daughter live here. Track them down, capture them, and drag them back to your shop to serve justice… and meat.

Chop Your Victims

Capture people from Ratwood, store them in prison cells, and prepare them for processing. Use chains and equipment to organize your butchering area efficiently.

Manage Your Butcher Shop

Display body parts on your shelves and wait for the zombies to pay you in precious gold. Expand your shop with new sections, upgrade your equipment, and don’t forget to add jars of eyeballs for that extra touch!

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains graphic depictions of violence, including murder, dismemberment, and disturbing imagery. Themes include survival in a decaying, hostile world where players interact with morally ambiguous characters and make unsettling choices. There are no sexual themes present, but the game features scenes of intense gore and acts of brutality.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2500K / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti / AMD Radeon RX 560
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9400F / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 Ti / AMD Radeon RX 6600
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

short_description: Run your old butcher shop to survive by selling human meat to zombies. Get closer to your daughter’s killers with each step, seeking justice in a lawless world. In this flesh-fueled dystopia, you are the king of meat.
supported_languages:
English*, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Russian, Turkish
*languages with full audio support
